'''Wentross''' was an arms company that was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[ER-1N Bowcaster]] was among the [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] they produced.<ref name="Cartel Market">[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]]</ref>
